review_notes: The file has one theorem, replicaGibbsMass_tail. It uses a Fin.consEquiv change of variables, then factors the head sum out with Finset.mul_sum and gibbs_sum. I checked related code in the SKBarriers directory. That covered replicaGibbsMass_le_one, replicaGibbsMass_eq_ratio, replicaMarginal_sum and the flip lemmas in ReplicaFlip.lean. None of them repeats the cons-equivalence and head-marginalisation argument. Other uses of Fin.consEquiv in the repository are in unrelated domains with different summands. The only repeated step is the short `← Finset.sum_mul, gibbs_sum, one_mul` normalisation, which is below the rubric's threshold. I found no repeated nontrivial machinery and no shared lemma worth extracting. I did not search the whole repository exhaustively for a second proof of the same factorisation, so some uncertainty remains.
